sql: WITH scores AS (SELECT name,version,step,MAX(CASE WHEN model<>'Stack' THEN test_score END) baseline,MAX(CASE WHEN model='Stack' THEN test_score END) stack_score FROM model_score GROUP BY name,version,step), units AS (SELECT DISTINCT m.name,m.version,m.step,m.L1_model FROM model m JOIN scores s USING(name,version,step) WHERE m.L1_model IS NOT NULL AND baseline IS NOT NULL AND stack_score IS NOT NULL), counts AS (SELECT L1_model,COUNT(*) occurrences FROM units GROUP BY L1_model) SELECT L1_model,occurrences FROM counts WHERE occurrences=(SELECT MAX(occurrences) FROM counts) ORDER BY L1_model

WITH scores AS (SELECT name,version,step,MAX(CASE WHEN model<>'Stack' THEN test_score END) baseline,MAX(CASE WHEN model='Stack' THEN test_score END) stack_score FROM model_score GROUP BY name,version,step), units AS (SELECT DISTINCT m.name,m.version,m.step,m.L1_model FROM model m JOIN scores s USING(name,version,step) WHERE m.L1_model IS NOT NULL AND baseline IS NOT NULL AND stack_score IS NOT NULL), counts AS (SELECT L1_model,COUNT(*) occurrences FROM units GROUP BY L1_model) SELECT * FROM counts ORDER BY occurrences DESC

WITH s AS (SELECT name,version,step,MAX(CASE WHEN model<>'Stack' THEN test_score END) baseline,MAX(CASE WHEN model='Stack' THEN test_score END) stack_score FROM model_score GROUP BY name,version,step) SELECT m.L1_model,COUNT(*) model_steps,COUNT(DISTINCT m.name||':'||m.version) model_versions,SUM(baseline IS NOT NULL AND stack_score IS NOT NULL) comparable,SUM(stack_score>=baseline) noninferior,SUM(stack_score>baseline) strong FROM model m LEFT JOIN s USING(name,version,step) GROUP BY m.L1_model

WITH s AS (SELECT name,version,step,MAX(CASE WHEN model<>'Stack' THEN test_score END) baseline,MAX(CASE WHEN model='Stack' THEN test_score END) stack_score FROM model_score GROUP BY name,version,step) SELECT m.name,m.version,m.step,m.L1_model,baseline,stack_score FROM model m JOIN s USING(name,version,step) WHERE stack_score<baseline ORDER BY m.name,m.version,m.step LIMIT 12

WITH scores AS (SELECT name,version,step,MAX(CASE WHEN model<>'Stack' THEN test_score END) baseline,MAX(CASE WHEN model='Stack' THEN test_score END) stack_score FROM model_score GROUP BY name,version,step), units AS (SELECT DISTINCT m.name,m.version,m.step,m.L1_model FROM model m JOIN scores s USING(name,version,step) WHERE m.L1_model IS NOT NULL AND baseline IS NOT NULL AND stack_score IS NOT NULL), counts AS (SELECT L1_model,COUNT(*) occurrences FROM units GROUP BY L1_model) SELECT L1_model,occurrences FROM counts WHERE occurrences=(SELECT MAX(occurrences) FROM counts) ORDER BY L1_model

WITH scores AS (SELECT name,version,step,MAX(CASE WHEN model<>'Stack' THEN test_score END) baseline,MAX(CASE WHEN model='Stack' THEN test_score END) stack_score FROM model_score GROUP BY name,version,step) SELECT m.L1_model,COUNT(*) n,COUNT(DISTINCT m.name||':'||m.version||':'||m.step) model_steps,SUM(m.step<>s.step) cross_step_rows,SUM(stack_score>=baseline) noninferior_rows FROM model m JOIN scores s USING(name,version) WHERE baseline IS NOT NULL AND stack_score IS NOT NULL GROUP BY m.L1_model

WITH scores AS (SELECT DISTINCT name,version,step FROM model_score) SELECT m.name,m.version,m.step model_step,s.step score_step,m.L1_model FROM model m JOIN scores s USING(name,version) WHERE m.name='Critical Heat Flux' AND m.version=1 ORDER BY m.step,s.step
SELECT L1_model,COUNT(*) n,COUNT(DISTINCT name||':'||version) versions,MIN(step) first_step,MAX(step) last_step FROM model GROUP BY L1_model
